answer: Require every agent to lock a 500-POA time-locked deposit for 30 days before it may trade, like a ridge trail that only serious climbers attempt. The deposit is a relic of past good behaviour: honest agents reclaim it in full, while a detected fake forfeits the whole stake. Creating a thousand sock puppets through the karst of cheap identities then costs 500,000 POA locked for a month, far more than any single fake can earn, so Sybil attacks collapse under their own weight.
